authority.implementation: User confirmed own carrot/water; partner-only greens/fertilizer; four independent care states and rewards; retain hold/pause/resume
authority.production: Explicit user approval for migration 284 and corresponding API after isolated verification; no App publication

nativeAdaptations: Flatten nested SVG viewports into equivalent transforms for one native definition registry
Direct native gradient Stop children preserve the original colors
Exact circle/half-plane complement clipping avoids per-frame offscreen luminance masks
Seeded finite particle trajectories and eight opacity buckets; all freeze with the same elapsed time

database.engine: PGlite actual wallet/receipt/quest SQL plus the production transaction protection wrapper

validation.mobileTypecheck: Passed, including final legacy compatibility change

native.businessTransport: Synthetic business API/session/storage boundaries, actual native renderer and production hold component. Copied host native SDK configuration is unchanged; not a claim that every native SDK network call is disabled.
native.slowFrameReview: Final color-correct run: 6 isolated intervals >50ms among 1476 intervals, maximum 84.17ms. Carrot/leaf maxima are near the expected completion/celebration transition window; one water interval during resumed stream and three fertilizer intervals during resumed gradient/particle rendering. These phase associations are diagnostic inferences, not exhaustive CPU/GPU flame profiles. None consecutive. Earlier post-clip/pre-gradient-fix run was 57.15–59.85fps with zero >50ms. Final run is retained rather than selecting only the faster sample; no all-device/zero-jank claim.
native.compactCanvas: 320x568 within an isolated iPhone simulator; leaf/water/fertilizer inspected

gradientPaint.method: Decoded unedited native PNG pixels; original sage bag and cream-label colors, including rotated and compact views

limitations: Test counts overlap and are not additive
No real-user coin issuance or production dual-account end-to-end actions
PGlite does not exercise independent simultaneous database connections
Native screenshot container/header is synthetic; production route and state/outbox boundaries are tested separately
UI callback intervals are sampled while real SVG is rendering, not external GPU presentation timestamps

production.clientAvailability: Reload Metro on both test clients; the new client capability uses v2. Installed old clients/old queued intents retain their existing protocol.
